name: reshape
description: Clean a dirty Excel Table into a new table: dedupe, unpivot, split column, coerce types

tools.name: reshape_table
tools.description: Reshape one Excel Table and WRITE A NEW SHEET only (never overwrite the source). op: dedupe (keep first row per key), unpivot (wide→long), split (one column by separator), coerce (number|text|date). Table must already exist (use ensure_table first).

idColumns.description: unpivot: columns that stay. Default: first column

valueColumns.description: unpivot: columns to melt. Default: all except idColumns

attributeName.description: unpivot: name of the new attribute column. Default 属性

valueName.description: unpivot: name of the new value column. Default 值

maxParts.description: split: max new columns. Default = max observed

outputSheet.description: New sheet name. Default 去重结果 / 反透视结果 / 拆列结果 / 类型结果
